limitations: Historical source revisions and human-known history prevent real-time/untouched certification
Five retrospective eras give wide statistical uncertainty; calibration is not a future guarantee
Twenty-one synthetic sessions per month do not establish actual future exchange closures
Daily variance templates are a conditional scenario assumption, not reconstructed observations
No bond total-return series in this panel: stock/bond correlation forecasts remain BLOCKED
No executable strategy or account wealth is calculated in this forecast-validation study

protocol.auxiliary_outcome: equity_log_variance: observed within-month sum of centered daily log-return squares, never a known future trading signal
protocol.confirmation_scope: New forecast-evaluation intervals must not overlap the prior consumed forecast batches; all historical eras remain retrospective, human-known diagnostics, including already published historical counterfactual summaries. No claim of pristine human-independent history.

convergence.scope: Sampling precision is separate from model validity; failed convergence remains failed, no path deletion

protocol.daily_forecast_clock: 21 synthetic sessions per forecast month; realized sessions counted explicitly; no future actual closure calendar is read before freezing
protocol.missing_data: No macro interpolation or discontinuous historical blocks; preserve missing rows and exclude invalid transitions
protocol.old_eras: The original 26 forecasts are immutable diagnostics only; no candidate promotion on their outcomes
protocol.purpose: Research improvement test, not a relabeled untouched holdout or authority to deploy

registry_decision.authority: Research model only; never trading strategy/live deployment
